home.faqs.0.copy: MetKurd AI is a Kurdish-first AI SaaS platform focused on Sorani Kurdish speech, text, OCR, translation, and audio tools.
home.faqs.0.title: What is MetKurd AI?
home.faqs.1.copy: MetKurd AI is free to start. Users receive free credits, and paid subscriptions or add-ons are available when more usage is needed.
home.faqs.1.title: Is MetKurd AI free?
home.faqs.2.copy: The primary focus is Sorani Kurdish. Kurmanji is not currently supported.
home.faqs.2.title: Which Kurdish dialect does MetKurd AI support?
home.faqs.3.copy: Kurdish text to speech converts written Kurdish text into speech audio. MetKurd AI provides this with TTS Apollo and TTS Delta.
home.faqs.3.title: What is Kurdish text to speech?
home.faqs.4.copy: Voice cloning uses a short sample to reproduce a similar speaking style. MetKurd AI provides this through CTTS Vector for Sorani Kurdish output.
home.faqs.4.title: What is Kurdish voice cloning?
home.faqs.5.copy: A clean 10 to 30 second sample is recommended. Results depend on sample quality and may vary.
home.faqs.5.title: How much audio is needed for voice cloning?
home.faqs.6.copy: Speech-to-text transcribes spoken Kurdish audio into text. MetKurd AI provides this with NEO and LEO.
home.faqs.6.title: What is Kurdish speech-to-text?
home.faqs.7.copy: Yes, with varying quality based on audio clarity, dialect, and the selected model.
home.faqs.7.title: Can AI understand Kurdish audio?
home.faqs.8.copy: Kurdish OCR extracts text from images and PDFs, especially Arabic-script Kurdish documents. MetKurd AI provides this with OCR-CKB.
home.faqs.8.title: What is Kurdish OCR?
home.faqs.9.copy: Yes. TRANS-CKB supports Kurdish-focused translation workflows with strong coverage for Kurdish, Arabic, and English use cases.
home.faqs.9.title: Can AI translate Kurdish?
home.faqs.10.copy: TTS generates speech from text using built-in voices. Voice cloning generates speech in a style based on an uploaded voice sample.
home.faqs.10.title: What is the difference between TTS and voice cloning?
home.faqs.11.copy: OCR extracts text from documents and images. Transcription converts spoken audio into text.
home.faqs.11.title: What is the difference between OCR and transcription?
home.faqs.12.copy: Yes. Businesses use MetKurd AI for customer support localization, marketing audio, documentation, translation, and content workflows.
home.faqs.12.title: Can businesses use MetKurd AI?
home.faqs.13.copy: MetKurd AI does not currently offer a public API. API access may be considered in the future.
home.faqs.13.title: Is there a public API?
home.faqs.14.copy: AI output may contain mistakes. Quality depends on input conditions and is continuously being improved.
home.faqs.14.title: Is Kurdish AI always accurate?
home.faqs.15.copy: High-quality recordings, clean documents, better language data, manual review, and continuous model updates improve output quality.
home.faqs.15.title: How can Kurdish AI quality be improved?
home.faqs.16.copy: Users must only clone voices they are authorized to use and must avoid misleading, harmful, or unauthorized content.
home.faqs.16.title: Is voice cloning safe and permission-based?
home.faqs.17.copy: No. MetKurd AI states that user uploads and generated outputs are not used for training.
home.faqs.17.title: Does MetKurd AI use uploads for training?
home.faqs.18.copy: Yes. Customers can manage storage by deleting files in their account.
home.faqs.18.title: Can I delete my files?

research_development_page.sections.0.cop: Kurdish AI data was difficult to collect, so the team recorded and prepared data manually for practical model training and evaluation workflows.
research_development_page.sections.1.cop: Kurdish spelling and word correctness were reviewed with Kurdish language teachers and academic reviewers to improve quality and linguistic consistency.
research_development_page.sections.2.cop: A lack of official and dependable dictionaries created additional validation challenges in normalization, correction, and lexical alignment.
research_development_page.sections.3.cop: Output quality depends heavily on data quality, so data cleaning, annotation discipline, and repeated evaluation remain central to progress.
research_development_page.sections.4.cop: Different approaches and models were tested across speech and text workflows to improve real-world usability for Kurdish users.
research_development_page.title: How MetKurd AI approaches Kurdish AI research and development
